import collections
def purpos(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c] in ('p','P')]
    if not cells: return None
    rs = [r for r,c in cells]; cs = [c for r,c in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
def dots(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c = collections.Counter(((r-9)//6,(c2-7)//6) for r in range(9,60) for c2 in range(7,60) if a[r][c2] in ('N','g'))
    return {k:v for k,v in c.items()}

    action([d])
